items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He wanted that back again. But Wynonie Harris was dead and gone.

ctx.x: But you knew that on his label Charlie Parker recorded.
Right. I mean, then he had a big thing with Wynonie Harris. That was his biggest thing. He wanted that back again. But Wynonie Harris was dead and gone.
So he basically saw you as a guy who might be able to give him some hits the way Wynonie Harris had given him some r-and-b.
